status: Retrospective protocol frozen after reading the paper and checking model compatibility, before full scoring. Not blinded or preregistered.
material: Cod frame MCF; HCM is heated, deboned cod meat and is not a pure temperature control.
recipes: Alcalase 2.4 or Neutrase 0.8, 50 C, pH 7.4, E/S 1.5% reported; singles 3 h; Neutrase then Alcalase 2x3 h. Stage-specific dosage and costs not inferred.
reference_proteome: Ensembl release 90 gadMor1, matching the paper's older assembly. Only source-ID and exact-sequence verified mappings used. The other assembly and unidentified parents remain excluded from virtual digestion validation.

functional_models.AnOxPePred: Original v1 checkpoint, 3-30 standard amino acids. Outputs are model scores, not measured IC50 or calibrated industrial activity probabilities.
functional_models.EmulsiPred: Original Kyte-Doolittle normalization and functions; 7-30 aa. Max(alpha,beta,gamma) preselected aggregate; individual scores retained. No assumed experimental secondary structure.
functional_models.compatibility: Published peptide anchors checked, no score fitting to paper outcomes. Exact overlap with published training data flagged. Homology/training-source leakage cannot be fully excluded.

release_validation.scope: End-state, sequence-only empirical cleavage surrogate, not kinetics, enzyme mechanism or yield prediction. The sequential condition is fitted to its own observed end state; enzyme order is not simulated or inferred by site unions.
release_validation.parent_set: MS-identified parents with exact sequence mapping; selection favors detectable proteins.
release_validation.split: Union components of proteins sharing any exact 10-mer, plus any possible parent IDs of the same observed peptide of length >=7. Hash lexicographically smallest component ID with SHA256; modulo 5 ==0 held out. Exclude any training peptide of length 7-30 that appears anywhere in held-out sequences. Residual remote homology can remain.
release_validation.fit: Per condition, only By MS/MS and PEP<=0.01, length7-30; distinct parent/start/end. Count cleaved terminal bonds versus intact internal bonds by adjacent amino-acid pair. Shrink each pair to global cut frequency with 20 pseudo observations. No parameter search.
release_validation.score: Log probability of two terminal cuts and no internal cuts under an independent-bond surrogate. Protein natural termini require no cut. Full enumeration of length7-30 in held-out full-length proteins, standard residues only. Same sequence deduplicated using maximum occurrence score.
release_validation.baselines: Global-cut-frequency length/terminus-only model; random expected recall.
release_validation.metrics: Recall of high-confidence observed peptides within top1% and10% unique candidates, enrichment over random. Missing spectra are not true biological negatives; no biological specificity or calibrated release probability claimed.
release_validation.scale: Functionally score union of top10000 unique virtual peptides from each of six conditions; retain full enumerated candidate scores in compressed output. This is an out-of-protein-study holdout, not an independent batch or species validation.

bulk_validation.primary: Intensity-weighted model-score mean among in-domain peptides for FRS versus negative DPPH IC50, chelator versus negative Fe2+ IC50, max Emulsi score versus EAI. ESI secondary.
bulk_validation.sensitivity: Unweighted means; high-confidence By MS/MS, PEP<=0.01 only; predicted activity scores on length>=10 subset; fraction/intensity coverage reported.
bulk_validation.baselines: Same-domain intensity-weighted peptide length and GRAVY. Both endpoint signs described rather than selecting the winning direction after inspection.
bulk_validation.statistics: Spearman across six conditions, exact 720-permutation descriptive p-values, and within-material ordering. No confidence intervals based on treating six recipes as biological replicates. Published SD and significance groups retained; same-group results not asserted as distinct winners.
bulk_validation.limitation: Peptide composition comes from MS. Aggregate validation is retrospective measurement-informed association. No synthesized-peptide assays in this case; bulk associations cannot establish individual peptide activity.

performance: Record downloads/setup separately from measured compute; process-tree RSS sampled each second, wall time, CPU seconds and system swap. These runs do not benchmark OpenFold or Vina.
deliverables: Auditable inputs/versions/hashes, sequence provenance, model scores, release validation, functional ranking, condition tradeoffs, resource measurements, Chinese report, and explicit failure findings.
